fields.name: ImpactDirection
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1959370: piVar15[2..4] = the impact vector (read from the death impact component +0xC, default FLT_MAX each) rotated by the inverse of the character's rotation quaternion, i.e. impact direction in character space. Live: -inf, NaN, NaN (FLT_MAX rotated when there was no impact).

open_questions: Exact meaning of the byte at +4.
Enum names of AnimationType values 4..11 (no SE enum found).

The failed raw check is a false alarm: with no impact the source vector is FLT_MAX, and FLT_MAX rotated by the inverse character rotation gives -inf / NaN, which the checker does not accept as ordinary floats.
status_reason: the raw check failed: client entity 126100798156315802: ImpactDirection: glm::vec3 part 2 is not an ordinary float; client entity 126100798156320001: ImpactDirection: glm::vec3 part 2 is not an ordinary float
second_pass: All offsets come from the Windows writer bg3.exe+0x1959370 (int at +0, byte at +4, vec3 at +8 written through bg3.exe+0x195CFC0); confirmed that the vec3 is the DeathImpactComponent +0xC vector (read through bg3.exe+0x195CDC0) rotated into character space, so the NaN / inf samples are expected values.
